title: Physical-reduction architecture discrimination by vertical Richards coarsening
purpose: Determine whether training-free vertical coarsening of the same Richards physics provides a broader and scientifically competitive reduced-model family before investing in a quasi-steady or learned successor.

scientific_role.statement: Spatially coarsened Richards is treated as a legitimate deliberately reduced physical model, not merely as a benchmark that must lose to a learned ROM.

authority.reference_route: current-canonical F-ROM1A-I0 one-advance observation seam plus frozen research-only strict-first fallback policy
authority.constitutive_model: same B01 Mualem-van Genuchten parameters at every grid resolution

exposed_development_workload.forcing_sequences: exact F-ROMV2-V1 D01-D08 and V01-V04 sequences

invariants: same physical forcing rates and prescribed bottom heads
same hard accepted-step transaction mass gate of 1e-12 cm

profile_outputs.rule: Profile fidelity is diagnostic and resolution-aware, not a universal acceptance requirement.
profile_outputs.R8_mapping: compare each 20 cm R8 cell theta/head with average of corresponding two 10 cm R16 cells
profile_outputs.R4_mapping: compare each 40 cm R4 cell with average of corresponding four R16 cells
profile_outputs.R2_mapping: compare each 80 cm R2 cell with average of corresponding eight R16 cells

computational_proxies.interpretation: Node count and solver work are architecture proxies only. They do not substitute for isolated-host end-to-end timing.

analysis.normalization: Report absolute errors and errors relative to the magnitude/range of the corresponding R16 signal where informative. Do not turn observed ratios into acceptance thresholds.
analysis.frontier: Report non-dominated candidates separately for cumulative/balance fidelity and transient/event fidelity versus structural computational proxies.

decisions.selection_rule: No single winner is chosen by a weighted score. Retain every geometry that is non-dominated on at least one declared fidelity/cost view and satisfies integrity.
integrity_kill: physical water content outside B01 theta bounds
accepted-step transaction mass residual exceeds 1e-12 cm
frozen research Reference policy cannot produce the preregistered history without an unclassified failure

successor_logic.if_coarse_richards_competitive: Carry the strongest non-dominated coarse grid(s) directly into later purpose-specific cost-fidelity qualification. A quasi-steady manifold must then beat or complement them, not merely beat R16.
successor_logic.if_coarse_richards_not_competitive: Proceed to an independently specified quasi-steady/integrated-manifold physical reduction.
successor_logic.if_tradeoff_split: Retain coarse Richards for event-sensitive/high-fidelity use and test quasi-steady reduction for regional/groundwater-coupled balance use.
